title: Uber uses OpenAI to help people earn smarter and book faster
summary: Uber uses OpenAI to power AI assistants and voice features that help drivers earn smarter and riders book faster across a global real-time marketplace.
body: Uber uses OpenAI to power AI assistants and voice features that help drivers earn smarter and riders book faster across a global real-time marketplace.
summaryZh: Uber宣布与OpenAI达成合作，利用其AI技术赋能平台内的AI助手与语音交互功能。该集成旨在优化司机的接单体验与乘客的预订流程，通过实时处理能力提升全球市场的运营效率。此案例展示了大型互联网平台如何将大模型能力深度嵌入核心业务场景，以实现更智能的供需匹配与用户服务。

aiReview.reasonZh: Uber通过集成OpenAI技术优化了其全球实时市场的语音交互与服务效率。
